cards.card_text: Sons, daughters, servants and even the foreigner within your gates get the day off, so NOBODY gets the "hey, can you cover a shift?" call.
cards.verse_text: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant or livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates.
